prompt: Add a guard to the check script so nobody changes the DataStore name by accident.
result:
I added a DataStore name guard to `scripts/check.sh`. I haven't run the script, so the guard is untested. I did confirm that `src` has exactly one `GetDataStore(...)` call, `GetDataStore("PlayerData_v3")` in `src/server/PlayerData.luau`, which is what the guard expects.

It runs before `rokit install`, so it fails fast. It collects every `GetDataStore(...)` call under `src` and fails with a message listing what it found unless there is exactly one and it is `GetDataStore("PlayerData_v3")`. That also catches a second store being added, or the call being removed.

To rename the store on purpose, change `EXPECTED_DATASTORE` in `scripts/check.sh` in the same commit. The comment above it says a rename needs a data migration, since players' saved coins live under the old name.

The guard only matches string-literal names. If the name ever moves into a constant or a variable, it will report "found: `GetDataStore(NAME)`" and need adjusting.

written.scripts/check.sh:
#!/usr/bin/env bash
set -euo pipefail
cd "$(dirname "$0")/.."

# Renaming the store orphans every player's saved data; update this together with a migration.
EXPECTED_DATASTORE='GetDataStore("PlayerData_v3")'
datastore_calls=$(grep -rhoE 'GetDataStore\([^)]*\)' src || true)
if [ "$datastore_calls" != "$EXPECTED_DATASTORE" ]; then
	echo "DataStore guard: expected exactly one $EXPECTED_DATASTORE in src, found:" >&2
	echo "${datastore_calls:-<none>}" >&2
	exit 1
fi

rokit install
wally install
stylua --check src
selene src
rojo build default.project.json -o build/arena.rbxlx
